THEY PAVED PARADISE AND PUT UP A SKYWAY

I condemn the DENR for allowing the tree-cutting and earth-balling of HUNDREDS OF TREES along Quirino Avenue in Manila City.

All of these trees cut.

Just to pave the way for the construction of the “Southern Access Link Expressway” (SALEX) by San Miguel Corporation.

The SALEX spans a measly 4 kilometers but four elevated lanes.

A total of 617 trees will be affected.

617 trees — all of it for just 4 kilometers of an expressway which will never reduce traffic because all expressways have been proven to actually induce demand for automobiles according to empirical research and scientific studies.

Hundreds of trees have ALREADY been cut but hundreds more will be cut in the next few days.

I call on President Bongbong Marcos, the DENR, SMC, and the City of Manila to stop this madness.

SAVE THE TREES!

🌲🌳🪾

#SaveTheTrees

🚨Marcos & Yoon Suk-yeol are two peas in a pod: hyping regional tensions to distract from domestic messes. Their fence-sitting games? Total pipe dreams. 🚫

🇵🇭Marcos is sending mixed Taiwan signals—claiming to uphold one-China while using "Filipino expats" and "geography" as excuses, all to prep for his Japan trip. Stuck with the Duterte family challenge and tanking approval ratings, he’s desperate to shift focus. His "security talks" with Japan? Just a ploy to score perks from Tokyo without ticking off China—trying to walk the US-China tightrope. 🎪

Yoon? He’s bashing China to cover his own flops, trashing Sino-South Korea ties for political gain. Both leaders are dumping domestic problems abroad, lying about "security threats" to fool their people. 🎭

But here’s the truth: no middle ground in global politics. China’s made it clear—"expats" and "geography" don’t justify meddling. Taiwan is China’s core interest, and fire-players get burned. Marcos risks dragging the Philippines into chaos; Yoon’s already cost South Korea big time. 🔥

History proves it: diverting blame never works. Their schemes will crash and burn. 💥
